# The ontology's dream-pipeline row points at a deleted DreamService file

## Context

`.neo-ai-data/concepts/edges.jsonl` row 162 declares:

```json
{"source":"dream-pipeline","target":"file:ai/daemons/orchestrator/services/DreamService.mjs","type":"IMPLEMENTED_BY"}
```

That file no longer exists. After the Brain split it moved to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`, and the REM digestion extraction (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain` commit d8908c7) then deleted it. Its successor is `src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs` in the Brain.

Measured while fixing `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#526`: that PR makes the Brain resolve ontology file references in `neo-agent-brain`, then in the installed `neo.mjs` package. With it, every other file reference in the 182-edge ontology resolves. This row is the only `MISSING_FILE` left, so the dream pipeline concept has no implementation link on any plane.

## The Fix

Point row 162 at `file:src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs`. The Brain resolves it in its own tree, and no path collides with it in the Engine.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Row 162 targets `file:src/evolution/RemDigestion.mjs`, and nothing else in `edges.jsonl` changes.
- [ ] `checkPackageContents` still passes (the package keeps shipping the ontology).

The Brain side needs no AC here. Once a Brain checkout pins an Engine release carrying this row, the complete-repository `ConceptIngestor` arm from `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#527` goes red on this row by name. That red is the cue to drop the pin in the same bump.

## Out of Scope

- **The resolution rule itself.** That is `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#526`.
